title: Z Bollard
summary: An outdoor bollard shaped like a leaning Z. The LED sits in the top arm and lights the path below, and a wooden wedge anchors the base.
summary_ar: عمود إنارة خارجي على شكل حرف Z مائل. مصباح LED في الذراع العلوية يضيء الممر تحته، وقطعة خشب مائلة تثبّت القاعدة.

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: I designed this bollard during my internship at 3 Brothers for Lighting (Feb–May 2025), as part of my work on their outdoor lighting units. It stayed a concept and did not go into production.

sections.heading: Built to be taken apart
sections.body: An aluminium body leans on a wooden wedge base. The CAD model is a full assembly of 9 parts and 17 standard ISO screws, so you can take it apart right here on the site.

images.caption: The assembly taken apart, rendered from the CAD model
